questions.text:
What is the output of the following Python program?

```python
def calculate_score(points):
    return sum(p for p in points if p >= 50)

scores = [35, 50, 75, 40]
print(calculate_score(scores))
```
questions.hint: Only values >= 50 are included in the sum: 50 + 75 = 125.
